name: Haven Today
subtitle: Daily programs and devotionals from Haven Ministries
description:
Haven Today is the official app of Haven Ministries, a source of daily Christ-centered programs and devotionals.

Listeners can browse programs by topic or Bible passage and follow along with the passage on screen while a program plays. The app also carries the daily Anchor devotional and the day's Bible in a Year reading, and makes it easy to share a program with friends.

It runs on iPhone, iPad and Android phones.
